biotools.summary: Reproducible command-line calculation of a transparent, uncalibrated GIST phenotype research score from explicit tumor features. Supports validated TSV, CSV, and JSON cohort inputs with deterministic component outputs. Research-only; not a probability, clinical decision rule, diagnostic, or treatment recommendation.
